blender.name: Salon furniture & decor
blender.detail: medallion chairs, settee, round table with its linen cloth, writing desk, quill and inkwell, painter's easel and palette, crystal chandelier, candelabra, sconces, marble fireplace, mantel clock, gilded mirror, marble bust, vases of roses, velvet curtains and swags, books

blender.name: The birthday tea table
blender.detail: tiered cake, porcelain tea service, chocolate pot, cake stand of macarons and petits fours, pineapple centrepiece, wish casket, silver salver, candlestick, gift

original: Made for this project: the room (parquet, panelled walls, windows, ceiling medallion, rug), the twilight view of 18th-century Vienna, toon shading with ink outlines, the portraits' gilded frames and plaques, the self-playing instruments, the quill's writing and the golden star-writing, the day-flip calendar, the painted-portrait effect, candle flames, golden dust, fireworks, rose petals and all synthesised sounds.
